quote_text: We cloned these 1,000 enhancer and 1,000 promoter sequences in all pairwise combinations, transfected the plasmid pool into K562 cells in 4 biological replicates of 50 million cells each and sequenced each STARR-seq RNA and input DNA library to a depth of at least 2.6 billion and 470 million reads, respectively (Extended Data Fig. 1c).
